name: engram-hooks
description: Nudges Claude Code / Codex to actually use the Engram MCP memory server — search before starting work, and remember non-trivial changes before finishing.

interface.shortDescription: Nudges agents to actually use the Engram MCP memory server
interface.longDescription: Mechanically enforces the Engram memory workflow instead of relying on the model to self-police it: blocks `remember` until a `search`/`recall` has run this session, reminds to search at session start, and prompts a self-report before Stop once enough file-editing tool calls have accumulated since the last remember. Installable in both Claude Code and Codex from the same manifest.
